story_summary: A solitary woman, feeling insignificant amidst the twilight gloom of Paris, channels her profound sorrow into a powerful, defiant dance. She confronts the wind and rain on slick stone steps, transforming her pain into a theatrical performance of resilience against the gothic noir cityscape.

characters.name: Indila
characters.visual_design: A woman with dark, wind-swept hair and a determined, melancholic expression, wearing a striking, tailored crimson velvet coat over a simple dark dress.

story_beats.title: Douce Souffrance
story_beats.description: At the top of rain-slicked stone steps, Indila pauses under a vintage streetlamp, her face a mask of sweet suffering as she feels the weight of her solitude and insignificance.

story_beats.title: Remue le Ciel
story_beats.description: She begins her descent, her initial hesitant steps transforming into the first powerful movements of a graceful, defiant dance, her crimson coat beginning to flow with the wind.

story_beats.title: Danse avec la Pluie
story_beats.description: In a storm of motion at the midpoint of the steps, she fully embraces the elements, head thrown back and arms outstretched, her coat a vibrant crimson swirl against the dark, wet city.

story_beats.title: Final Freeze-Frame
story_beats.description: The dance concludes at the bottom of the steps. She stands still, soaked but unbroken, gazing into the amber-lit Parisian night with a look of quiet, resolute strength.

panels.caption: Oh ma douce souffrance... pourquoi s'acharner ?
Je ne suis qu'un être sans importance...
Je remue le ciel, le jour, la nuit...
Je danse avec le vent, la pluie...
